summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across Ukraine employing Geran-5 rockets, reactive Shaheds, and Banderoil cruise missiles targeting at least ten oblasts including Kyiv, Vinnytsia, and Dnipropetrovsk. Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge railway section with at least two hits and attacked the Ilsky and Afipsky refineries in Krasnodar Krai, contributing to a reported 45% drop in Russian refining capacity. Russian strikes hit Naftogaz facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava oblasts and killed four civilians in Odesa.
key_points: Russia conducted a coordinated overnight strike using Geran-5 rockets, reactive Shaheds, and Banderoil cruise missiles against at least ten Ukrainian oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)
Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge railway section with at least two hits, per local Crimean Wind channel, while road spans remain destroyed. (Source: @eRadarrua/131651)

Ukrainian drones hit the Ilsky and Afipsky refineries in Krasnodar Krai, causing intense explosions; Reuters reports 15 of 35 major Russian refineries damaged in November, cutting refining by 45%. (Source: @UkraineNow/85369, @UkraineNow/85384)
Russian missiles struck Naftogaz facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava oblasts; damage assessment ongoing. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)
Russian attacks on Odesa's historic center killed four and injured nine civilians in three strikes on the same day. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)
Poland thwarted a Russian diversion plot from Kaliningrad Oblast intended to attack Russian territory and frame Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85373)
DeepState map confirms Russian tactical advance near Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk Oblast. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24013)
Next prisoner exchange to involve 1,000+ persons prioritizing seriously ill, women, and longest-held captives. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)

points: Ukrainian forces conducted strikes on the Crimean Bridge railway section, with at least two hits reported by the Crimean Wind channel, while automobile spans and arches were previously destroyed. (Source: @UkraineNow/85370, @eRadarrua/131651)

Ukrainian drones attacked the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai overnight, with explosions heard every 30 seconds in Krasnodar; both are among the largest refineries in the region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85369)

Ukrainian forces destroyed a road bridge over the Siversky Donets near Stanytsia Luhanska used by Russians for ammunition, fuel, and equipment transport, and struck a repair base in Kursk Oblast. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)

Ukraine's allies announced new military aid packages at the Ramstein meeting, with 15 countries contributing to the PURL fund, fighter jet supplies, and air defense strengthening. (Source: @UkraineNow/85371)
The next prisoner exchange will involve over 1,000 persons, with priority given to the seriously ill, women, and those held longest in Russian captivity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)

Russian forces launched a massive overnight barrage employing Geran-5 rockets, reactive Shahed drones, and Banderoil cruise missiles targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Poltava, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, and Odesa regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)
Russian strikes hit Naftogaz energy infrastructure facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava oblasts; specialists are assessing consequences. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)
Russian forces attacked the historic center of Odesa three times on the same day, killing four civilians and injuring nine per the Odesa OVA. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)

Russian intelligence planned a large-scale diversion operation across the Polish border from Kaliningrad Oblast, intending to attack a target in Russia and plant false evidence of Ukrainian involvement; Polish services thwarted the plot. (Source: @UkraineNow/85373)

Russian reactive UAVs (БпЛА) were tracked in multiple directions: from Crimea toward Odesa, from Bryansk toward Chernihiv, from Kursk toward Sumy, and across central and eastern Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/131640, @eRadarrua/131637, @kpszsu/97271)
DeepState map update indicates Russian forces advanced near the settlement of Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk Oblast. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24013)
Russian KAB guided bombs were employed against Donetsk Oblast positions per monitoring channels. (Source: @kpszsu/97291)
Reactive UAVs were observed in the direction of Zaporizhzhia from the south and toward Kropyvnytskyi from the east. (Source: @kpszsu/97290, @kpszsu/97291)
Banderoil cruise missiles struck targets in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, including Pavlohrad and Dnipro, launched from Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)

Multiple reactive UAVs entered Chernihiv Oblast from Bryansk Oblast (Russia), passing near Berezna, Olyshivka, Honcharivske, and moving south toward Kyiv Oblast. (Source: @kpszsu/97271, @kpszsu/97273, @eRadarrua/131637)

Geran-5 rockets launched from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast's Vyshhorod and Boryspil districts; reactive Shaheds from Cherkasy toward Kyiv's Bila Tserkva district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423, @mon1tor_ua/78428)
Russian UAVs tracked near the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone moving westward across Kyiv Oblast. (Source: @kpszsu/97275)
Air defense activity reported in Kyiv, Vyshhorod, and surrounding districts with multiple Geran-5 impacts observed. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78432, @mon1tor_ua/78433, @mon1tor_ua/78434)

The Crimean Bridge railway section sustained at least two hits during a repeated attack; automobile spans and arches were previously destroyed. (Source: @UkraineNow/85370, @eRadarrua/131651, @mon1tor_ua/78431)
Russian forces launched three attacks on Odesa's historic center in one day, resulting in four dead and nine injured civilians. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)
Approximately seven UAVs were observed loitering over the Black Sea waters near Crimea. (Source: @eRadarrua/131683)
Reactive UAVs from Crimea headed toward Odesa Oblast; additional UAVs tracked near Mykolaiv (Snigurivka) and Kherson direction. (Source: @eRadarrua/131640, @eRadarrua/131682)
Overnight mass attack: at least 10 Geran-5 rockets, 8 reactive Shahed drones, and 4 Banderoil cruise missiles launched across Ukraine per monitoring data. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)

Geran-5 rockets targeted Kyiv/Vyshhorod, Zhytomyr (Korosten), Chernihiv to Kyiv, Kharkiv to Poltava; reactive Shaheds from Cherkasy to Vinnytsia (Haisyn), Kirovohrad to Vinnytsia, Crimea to Odesa, Cherkasy to Kyiv (Boryspil, Bila Tserkva). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423, @mon1tor_ua/78428)
Banderoil cruise missiles struck Pavlohrad, Dnipro, and Lozova (Kharkiv) launched from Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)

Reactive UAVs (БпЛА) detected in multiple vectors: from Crimea to Odesa, Bryansk to Chernihiv, Kursk to Sumy, Poltava to Cherkasy, Kirovohrad to Cherkasy and Vinnytsia, Kharkiv westward, Zaporizhzhia southward.
